verdict.rationale: Meltano is open-source and self-hostable, meaning users can deploy it in any region/infrastructure of their choosing to satisfy residency requirements, and community evidence confirms this self-host model is valued specifically for data-locality needs (data can't leave your network). However, there is no explicit region-selection feature, no managed multi-region hosting option details, and no documentation addressing data residency/compliance directly. missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, managed-cloud region selection, compliance documentation (GDPR/data residency).
